key_reasoning.reason: Two components touched across two layers: the Rust pty.rs command layer (new spawn_external_ps Tauri command, reusing the existing pty_env_pairs_for helper) and the JS handlers.js dispatch layer (new runExternalWindow path wired into the isWin branch for steps 2.3.3 and 2.3.5). Pattern mirrors the existing runPty sibling closely.

Uses the established portable-pty/tauri command pattern and an already-precedented CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE technique; covered by new unit tests in handlers.test.mjs and a Windows-only integration test (spawn_external_ps_exits_zero_for_noop_command) in pty.rs, so risk stays moderate rather than low.
